Lemma
[Nondegeneracy of a Tuple via its Gram Matrix]

↗ lem:nondegenerate-symmetric-bilinear

Let $(V,q)$ be a scalar product space and $(v_1,\ldots ,v_k)$ a tuple. Its span is nondegenerate of dimension $k$ if and only if the Gram matrix \[ G=(\langle v_i,v_j\rangle )_{i,j=1}^k \] is invertible.

Proof

↗ lem:nondegenerate-symmetric-bilinear \sketch If $G$ is invertible, pairing a linear relation or a vector in the restricted radical with all $v_j$ gives $Ga=0$, hence all coefficients vanish. Conversely, when the span is nondegenerate of dimension $k$, the tuple is its basis and $G$ is the matrix of the isomorphism induced by $q$ from the span to its dual.

□
